_comment: M3b implementation parameters for choices DESIGN v2 leaves open (one line each in docs/impl_notes_dictionary.md). DESIGN decision numbers stay in design_params.json; this file holds only implementation details (category maps, NA rules, file names). Code reads it via biomark.paths.load_config('build_params').

files.used_for: SIG: MSI, ploidy, WGD, CIN, LoH
files.fallback: MSI unknown (NA) for every line; no CMP fallback in DESIGN v3 (concordance only); ploidy/WGD/CIN/LoH/aneuploidy not built

files.used_for: SIG:TMB, SIG-SPEC spectra (alleles for CGT features: scripts/build_cgt_features.py)
files.fallback: TMB and SIG-SPEC not assayed; allele-level CGT tests 'untestable: allele'

files.used_for: covariate doubling_time (ScreenDoublingTime); screen QC kept as auxiliary columns
ID keys only (not needed: all used files are ModelID-keyed)

eligibility.stratum_size_counted_on: non-NaN D lines of the gene
eligibility.lines_in_small_strata: excluded from r_within for that gene
eligibility.eligibility_min_stratum_lines_comment: DESIGN amendment A6-(ii): lines in lineage x library strata with fewer than this many dev lines (non-NaN for the gene) are EXCLUDED from the beyond-lineage x library r, not pooled

dictionary.lof_bi_na_rule: 1 if any clause is true on available data; NA if dosage >= 1 and a clause needing missing CN or sex could make it true; else 0
dictionary.yabs_paralog_source: top-3 Ensembl paralogs located on chrY
dictionary.locus_distance: interval gap max(0, start_b - end_a) on the same chromosome
dictionary.locus_genes: genes with a call of that family in >= 1 CN-profiled D line among: features of the family (shared + gene-specific) and, for DEL, every gene-specific target gene
fusion_driver_sources: MOAlmanac Rearrangement records (gene1 = 5', gene2 = 3' when both given)
dictionary.nmf_input: D log2(TPM+1) of the n_top_var_genes genes with largest D variance; all population rows scored by model.transform
dictionary.amp_scope_rule: AMP:g is shared if g in Gamma, else gene-specific (own AMP of target g)

access_class_rules.direct: own EXPDOSE/EXPGATE, own AMP/DEL/LOSS (own CN), own LOFBI (own damaging), EXPPAR/DEL/LOFBI of a top-3 paralog
access_class_rules.potentially-direct: HOT (H matrix, M3 pool only), other LOFBI, AMP, DEL, LOSS (matrices C, M of the M3 pool)
access_class_rules.expression-derived: EXPDOSE, EXPPAR (non-paralog), PROG, PSCORE, SIL-DEL/MUT/METH/other, YABS
access_class_rules.proxy: SIG, FUS, ALLELE, CLIN, COMP, METH

dictionary.meth_lineage_median_rule: median over RRBS-profiled D lines of the lineage if >= lineage_min_lines such lines, else pan-D RRBS median
dictionary.sil_split_rule: SIL-<mech>:<g> mutually exclusive, precedence DEL > MUT > METH > other (R3-2); umbrella SIL is internal only (LOFBI clause, YABS)
dictionary.cgt_features_note: ALLELE/CLIN built in the dictionary from configs/cgt_allele_rules.json (CGT track, read-only); configs/cgt_features.csv = the built list with carrier counts
dictionary.fusion_5prime_drivers_extra_note: DEV-DICT-1 (PI ruling): extends design_params dictionary_s3.fusion.kinase_3prime_except_5prime, consistent with CGT CLIN:KMT2A_R
dictionary.failed_sanity_rule: a spectrum whose pre-declared sanity check fails is excluded from D as a determinant (PI ruling) and recorded as failed_sanity

controls.gate_eligible_rule: n_obs_D >= gate_min_nonnan_D_lines AND (primary or secondary feature in D_g with >= min_carriers D carriers among non-NaN lines (binary) or available (continuous))
